# bitty completion for Nushell (generated from the CLI grammar; do not edit).
# Install: bitty completion nushell | save -f ~/.config/nushell/completions-bitty.nu
#      then add `source ~/.config/nushell/completions-bitty.nu` to config.nu.
# Limitation (issue #2575): Nushell extern signatures are static, so
# `--profile` and `plugin enable|disable` complete only flags/words.
# Dynamic profile/plugin values are available in Bash, Zsh, Fish, and
# PowerShell; run `bitty +list-profiles` or
# `bitty +list-plugins --installed` manually for the same local data.
extern "bitty" [
    --help(-h)
    --version(-V)
    --verbose
    --log-level: string
    --headless
    --test-mode
    --safe
    --fail-loud
    --no-splash
    --split
    --split-ratio: string
    --stack
    --overlay
    --layout: string
    --focus: string
    --config: string
    --profile: string
    --theme: string
    --font-family: string
    --font-size: string
    --opacity: string
    --format: string
    --socket: string
    --instance: string
    --no-color
    --yes
    --force
    --scrollback: string
    --close-confirm: string
    --gaps-in: string
    --gaps-out: string
    --border: string
    --radius: string
    --plugins: string
    --no-plugins
    --with-components
    --no-with-components
    --no-components
    --without-components
    --print-shell-init
    --no-print-shell-init
    --no-shell-init
]
extern "bitty run" [
    ...args: string
    --cwd: string
    --env: string
    --title: string
    --help(-h)
    --version(-V)
    --verbose
    --log-level: string
    --headless
    --test-mode
    --safe
    --fail-loud
    --no-splash
    --split
    --split-ratio: string
    --stack
    --overlay
    --layout: string
    --focus: string
    --config: string
    --profile: string
    --theme: string
    --font-family: string
    --font-size: string
    --opacity: string
    --format: string
    --socket: string
    --instance: string
    --no-color
    --yes
    --force
    --scrollback: string
    --close-confirm: string
    --gaps-in: string
    --gaps-out: string
    --border: string
    --radius: string
    --plugins: string
    --no-plugins
    --with-components
    --no-with-components
    --no-components
    --without-components
    --print-shell-init
    --no-print-shell-init
    --no-shell-init
]

    --format: string
    --config: string

    --help(-h)

    --verbose

    --fail-loud
